comment: Metric-view base of mv_rm_engagement (D13 record_type union): record_type = 'activity' rows (one per CRM activity: RM, activity type, contact role, sentiment, follow-up status) and record_type = 'coverage' rows (one per golden client x month-end: primary RM, tier, touched / not touched in the last 90 days). Activity measures read activity rows (activity_count = 1, sentiment_score, is_next_action_open); coverage measures read coverage rows (client_month_count = 1, is_strategic_not_touched_90d) and are point-in-time - take the latest month, never sum across months. Each row belongs to exactly one record type, so no measure double counts. Grain: one row per CRM activity (record_type activity) or per golden client x month-end (record_type coverage).
